name: agent-safety-orchestrator
description: A training-free, defense-in-depth safety layer for LLM agents. 95 atomic safety capabilities across 19 archetypes and 5 execution phases, enforced by two layers: always-on deterministic hooks (block/warn before risky tool calls) and a model-invoked Router — the single entry skill — that routes the model to Read 14 phase-aware archetype reference docs (router-first hierarchy). Catches prompt injection, data exfiltration, supply-chain attacks (typosquat / hallucinated packages / CVEs), destructive shell commands, secret & PII leaks, and tool/MCP trust violations.
